QuestInfo.name: To the Top of the World!
QuestInfo.0:
You've reached the highest point in the forest. 
Here at the top of this cliff, there's a pine tree growing up and up. Even if the Sky Guardian isn't there, you'll be able to see the whole forest at the top.
QuestInfo.1:
How to climb a tree that tall?
While you were thinking about it, you heard a #bflapping sound#k from somewhere close by. What could it be?
QuestInfo.2:
You and Pan climbed to the highest spot in the forest. 
There on the #bOcean Cliff#k, you can see all the way to the distant horizon. Reasoning that the Sky Guardian might be at the forest's very highest point, you went for the tallest tree there.

While pondering how to climb that tree, you encountered a very snarky but very adorable bird.
As it flapped at you, a dark shadow grabbed his ankle. 

In that moment of shock, you experienced a flashback, and remembered the bird's name: #bPenni#k.
